nom: NIDA White Rice Whitehead Exfoliating Serum

avis.texte: Super impressed by the results from using this daily. Bought for my 13 year old son. His face had a combination of blackheads and whiteheads. He also has greasy skin on his face despite using a variety of face wash products. I bought this along with the Nida Blackhead Serum. He has been using the two products each evening after showering. His face has cleared up substantially. His cheeks and chin area are clear. His forehead is nearly clear. I highly recommend these products as we have tried so many other products that did nothing.
